name: product-frame
description: CSS-only device, browser, or terminal shell for a verified product screenshot or command transcript

kind.description: terminal, iphone, android, ipad, desktop, or browser

orientation.description: portrait or landscape; device-appropriate default when omitted

src.description: Verified screenshot URL or site-relative path; required for screen-based kinds

alt.description: Accurate description of the visible screenshot or neutral fixture

command.description: Verified terminal command; used only with kind=terminal

output.description: Verified terminal output; used only with kind=terminal

placeholder.description: Reserved for neutral development fixtures; never use as product evidence
